def get_gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

num_x, num_y, limit = map(int, input().split())
target = num_x / num_y
min_difference = 1e9
res_num = 0
res_den = 1

for i in range(1, limit + 1):
    b = (num_x * i) // num_y
    candidates = [
        b / i,
        abs(b - 1) / i,
        (b + 1) / i
    ]
    candidate_nums = [b, abs(b - 1), b + 1]

    for j in range(3):
        diff = abs(target - candidates[j])
        if diff < min_difference:
            min_difference = diff
            res_num = candidate_nums[j]
            res_den = i

if abs(1.0 - target) <= (abs(res_num / res_den) - target) + 1e-9:
    res_num = 1
    res_den = 1

g = get_gcd(res_num, res_den)
print(f"{res_num // g}/{res_den // g}")
